root_cause.text: The `p2pmem_alloc_mmap()` function in the PCI P2PDMA subsystem fails to release the acquired per-CPU reference of `pgmap` when `vm_insert_page()` fails, resulting in a reference count leak that prevents the PCI device from being removed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that inside `p2pmem_alloc_mmap()` in `drivers/pci/p2pdma.c`, a call to `percpu_ref_put(ref)` was added to the error path when `vm_insert_page(vma, vaddr, page)` returns a non-zero error code.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a reference count leak in p2pmem_alloc_mmap when vm_insert_page fails.
intent_record.what: Added a call to percpu_ref_put(ref) inside the error path of vm_insert_page failure in p2pmem_alloc_mmap.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the reference count on the percpu_ref object is properly decremented and released if mapping the page fails, preventing a reference leak.
